children.doc: The tolerance, the line separator and the IfcOpenShell kernel helpers every audit shares: the placement, the volume and bounds measured by the kernel, the authored records and the comparison helpers.
The classification and user property set audits: the classification parents, the type and element reference rows, the effective references and the written property values.
The element audits of the house, frame and annotation cases: the placement of products, the frame members, the authored phases and the annotations.
The wall-depth audits: the attached walls, the envelope volumes, the sweeps and the opening reveals against the shapely-adjudicated tables.
The ramp audit: the ramp flights and landings, their base quantities and railings against the ramp-runs table.
The component audit: the family solids, the instance frames, the bounds and sections of components and their base quantities and overrides.
The IFC4 template library table and its audit: the property set templates, the classification chain and the declarations.
